start: A member on Settings, app set to 'Same as phone', phone in dark mode

user_sees: Page 'Light or dark' with chips 'Same as phone', 'Light', 'Dark' under 'Colours'; 'Same as phone' picked; the line 'Same as phone: the app turns light or dark when your phone does.'
The whole app turns light at once
must_not: One part of the screen left dark; a restart needed

steps.action: Close and open the app again
must_not: The choice lost on the next launch

start: A member who logs in kg, on Settings

steps.action: Open a past workout and the Statistics page
user_sees: Every weight in lb with 'lb' named; metre exercises still in metres
must_not: A kg number shown with 'lb'; a saved weight changed by rounding

start: A member on an Android phone, notifications allowed, Workout reminders off

must_not: A reminder already set before the member turns it on

user_sees: The switch on; the usual training days and time picked the first time; seven day circles; caption with the next reminder
must_not: A reminder set for a day not picked

steps.action: Tap a day circle to remove it
user_sees: That day unpicked; the caption changes
must_not: A reminder still on the removed day

start: A member in a gym, on Settings, Reminders

user_sees: 'Reminders from my gym' with 'Your plan ending, birthday wishes and other news from <gym>, at 9:30 am. Never more than one a day.' and 'Messages from my gym' with 'Get a pop-up when <gym> sends news...'
must_not: These gym rows shown to a member with no gym
A plan-ending reminder still arriving after the switch is off

start: A member who blocked MettleUp's notifications in Android, with a reminder switch on

user_sees: Under Workout reminders: 'Turn on notifications'; under the gym switch: 'Notifications are off for MettleUp' with 'No reminder from your gym can arrive. Turn them on in your phone's settings.'
must_not: A caption saying reminders are set while nothing can arrive

steps.action: Tap the row, allow notifications, come back
must_not: The warning staying after notifications are allowed; the prompt shown on every visit

user_sees: No 'Reminders' row; the 'Not on iPhone yet' line names reminders
must_not: A reminders page that cannot ring

start: A member with Workout reminders and Reminders from my gym on

must_not: A reminder ringing after it is off

user_sees: The days and time chosen before come back
must_not: The first-time usual slot overwriting the member's own days

steps.action: Turn 'Reminders from my gym' off, then on
user_sees: On again: the gym's reminders are planned again
must_not: Two of the same reminder after on-off-on

start: A member in a gym, Reminders page

user_sees: The caption says what the gym sends and how often
must_not: A gym reminder that shows private plan details on the lock screen to anyone; more than one a day
